recentItems.title: వరద నీటిలో జుత్తిగ ఆలయం.. నిలిచిన పూజలు! | Flooding Disrupts Puja Rituals At Juttiga Temple
recentItems.description:
Floodwaters have inundated the famous Juttiga Sri Uma Vasuki Ravi Someswara Swamy Temple in West Godavari district, Andhra Pradesh, popularly known as Kashi Kshetram. Rising water levels in the Gosthani Drain due to heavy inflows from upstream areas have submerged several sub-temples within the temple premises. The Sri Subramanyeswara Swamy Temple is surrounded by knee-deep water, forcing the suspension of regular puja rituals. 
#JuttigaTemple #WestGodavari #AndhraPradesh #TempleFlooding #ETVDigital
